title: International organisations
log: 2026-11-12T12:44:18Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The new point is about international organisations such as the UN, WHO and World Bank running programs, and neither bank point teaches that idea; both cover wellbeing, development and Closing the Gap instead.

draft.title: International organisations
card: International organisations are groups set up by many countries working together. They fund and run programs to improve human wellbeing around the world.
a global body of member countries. Its agencies run programs on food, education and children's needs, such as the World Food Programme and UNICEF.
a United Nations agency that works on health. It helps countries fight disease, for example through vaccination programs.
a body that lends money and gives grants to countries for development, such as building roads, schools and clean water systems.
draft.remember: International organisations pool the efforts of many countries to fund and run wellbeing programs.

opts: A group of many countries that funds and runs programs
A charity that is run by one government alone
A local club that raises money for its own town
A company that sells health products for profit
a.why: International organisations are set up by many countries working together to fund and run programs. A body run by one government alone is not international, and a local club or a profit-making company does not match the card.
a.clue: Think about who sets the organisation up.

b.q: A country has no safe water supply and wants to build pipes and water treatment plants. Which organisation could lend it money for this?
b.why: The World Bank lends money and gives grants for development projects such as clean water systems. The World Health Organization is the most tempting wrong choice, because water affects health, but its work is helping countries fight disease, for example through vaccination.
b.clue: Which body lends money for development?

a.best: A group of many countries that funds and runs programs
